title: AS2: postfix ++/-- on member expressions returns new value instead of old (wrong semantics)
description: compileIncDecNonIdentifier() in compiler.ts (around lines 1913-1941) is called for obj.prop++, arr[i]++, etc. It always stores the NEW value in register r0 and returns it. Correct postfix semantics require saving the OLD value (before Inc/Dec) into r0. Fix: move StoreRegister r0 emission to immediately after GetMember (capturing oldValue), before the Inc/Dec opcode call. Only affects code where the postfix result is used as a value (e.g. var old = _root.score++). The prefix path is correct.
